en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.777 – He (Ali ibn Ja’far ) asked Him, Imam Musa ibn Jafar Al-Kadhim (as), about whether it is permissible for women and children to wear anklets.
Imam (as) said: "If they are silent (do not make noise), there is no harm, but if they produce sound, it is not appropriate”.
